## Session Brief

* [S1: a channel floor that scales with neval, measured on the bbx ladder](S1.md) - Design and implement a floor that grows with neval behind a selectable rule, size it offline, then run bbx_to_ccx_emmm_qcd0 at 600k and 1.2M over 20 paired seeds against today's floor, and measure what a default switch would move.

## Session Report

* [S1 report: a floor that scales with neval reaches the floor-bound channels and does not change the bbx ladder](S1-report.md) - ChannelFloor::ScalesWithBudget (512 accepted points up to neval 600 000, proportional above) is implemented beside today's floor, default unchanged and bit-identical. On bbx_to_ccx_emmm_qcd0, 20 paired seeds, it doubles every floor-bound channel's points at 1.2M (0 of 615 channels share counts with 600k) for 1.48x the points and 1.24x the wall time, and leaves the ladder where today's floor leaves it: seed sd 2.74e-9 -> 3.41e-9 (ratio 1.245; 0.901 without seed 55) against 2.74e-9 -> 3.34e-9 (1.220; 0.905), chi2/dof 1.70 against 1.43. The floor-held channels carry about 2% of the quoted variance; the excess is in alpha-share channels (613's seed-55 point), which no floor rule touches. Channel 551's quoted variance falls x0.39 (geometric mean) for x2 points but rises on 6 of 20 seeds.
